# proxmox_openid_login (Data Source)

Exchanges an OpenID authorization code through `/access/openid/login`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_openid_login" "login" {
  code         = "..."
  redirect_url = "https://pve-1:8006"
  state        = "..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String)
- `redirect_url` (String)
- `state` (String)

### Read-Only

- `cap` (String)
- `clustername` (String)
- `csrf_prevention_token` (String, Sensitive)
- `ticket` (String, Sensitive)
- `username` (String)
